description: Na₂AlH₄O₄Cl crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/nmm space group. Na is bonded to four equivalent O and two equivalent Cl atoms to form distorted NaCl₂O₄ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaCl₂O₄ octahedra, corners with four equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with four equivalent NaCl₂O₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 56°. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.43 Å. Both Na-Cl bond lengths are 3.04 Å. Al is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with eight equivalent NaCl₂O₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 58°. All Al-O bond lengths are 1.78 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Al, and one H atom. Cl is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Na atoms.
